hero.headline: Material recognition for household plastic
hero.subtext: Our AI judges whether a piece of plastic waste can go into pyrolysis, so mixed and dirty household plastic that mechanical recycling rejects becomes recycled feedstock instead of being incinerated.

vision.statCaption: Share of the 1,909,496 tonnes of plastic waste collected in Taiwan in 2021 that went to incineration (research estimate, includes non-commodity plastics).
vision.source: Source: 黃梓恩 (2023), master's thesis, National Taiwan University (in Chinese)
vision.line1: About half of the plastic waste Taiwan collects ends up in incinerators.
vision.line2: We want the household plastic in that half to have a chance to become recycled feedstock again.

home.esgDesc: Next, we will turn the photo and timestamp behind every judgment into the data companies need for waste-reduction and ESG reporting.
